result:
I would make empathy reflexive and contagious.

Not just the feeling of it, but the actual ability to instantly and accurately feel what another person is feeling, and to know that they can feel yours back.

Not perfect telepathy, just a moment of true, unfiltered understanding that kicks in before defensiveness does. It would change how we argue, how we buy, how we vote, how we raise kids, how we treat strangers. Most cruelty is just distance in disguise. Remove the distance and the world has to reorganize itself around that.
